title: A Space owner can publish their pages as a standalone website at /sites/<slug>, instead of a Coming soon page

source.ref: PROG-E10 phase 1 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708); lift report /mnt/project-files/white-label/2026-10-06-lift-report.md

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 as phase 1 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708, owner ruling: build the white label site section one piece at a time, danieltyack.com first, basic Space page blocks instead of the full editor). THE CONSEQUENCE: /sites/<slug> only ever rendered a Coming soon page, and the Publish website button on the Space page panel only revealed a Coming soon notice, so no Space could have a website. THE FIX: setWebsitePublished returns (owner/admin/editor-gated, writes preferences.websitePublished), the panel's button publishes and unpublishes and links to the live site, and /sites/<slug> plus /sites/<slug>/<page> render the Space's own page docs (the same ones the Space page editor saves) through SpaceLanding with an anonymous viewer, inside a slim site chrome (brand, page nav, footer) with no app shell. Fail-closed twice: a Private Space 404s, and an unpublished site keeps the Coming soon page. noindex stays on until the site SEO phase gives the site its own canonical, robots and sitemap. Next phases (ADR-1708): host routing in proxy.ts, binding danieltyack.com, site SEO, caching.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const page=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');const act=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/layout/actions.ts');const panel=r('components/spaces/space-page-panel.tsx');const miss=[];if(!/<SpaceLanding[^>]*anonymous/.test(page)||!/readWebsitePublished/.test(page))miss.push('the /sites render does not show the published page docs');if(!/export async function setWebsitePublished/.test(act))miss.push('there is no publish action');if(!/setWebsitePublished\(/.test(panel))miss.push('the Publish website button does not publish');if(!fs.existsSync('app/sites/[slug]/[page]/page.tsx'))miss.push('custom pages have no /sites route');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-741: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at its three seams: the public /sites render shows the Space's published page docs (anonymous viewer, publish-gated), a publish action exists, and the panel's button calls it; plus the custom-page route. Failed on main before this change (the route was a Coming soon page and setWebsitePublished was deleted).
